learnings: The eight settings live as DOTTED keys in one flat TypeBox object ('sql.maxRows', 'index.exclude'): smol-toml writes them as quoted keys and round-trips them exactly (verified on disk), while a nested Type.Object would never reach the form — packages/config's field model reads top-level properties only. A REQUIRED field that is legitimately empty blocks the global Save from the moment the section opens: ConfigForm's `invalid` is computed over every field while the error is only SHOWN once a field has been edited, so 'index.exclude' = [] left 'Save & apply' permanently disabled. Fixed here by making that one field Type.Optional (correct modelling anyway — an empty list is its normal state), but the same trap is live for Sync's empty serverUrl on a fresh install; it is a defect in ConfigForm, not in the schemas. The settings section is registered as a `component`, not a bare `schema`, because it also carries the index status and an immediate Reindex — the form inside it is still ConfigForm over the plugin's schema, and the staging dance is copied from SchemaSettingsPage (draftFor / stage / no local Save). The rebuild after a settings change calls search.reindex() directly rather than the status view's control: that control is inert while a walk runs, and a rebuild the settings demand has to happen even then. It is not awaited — a walk takes minutes and saveAll() is sequential. The plugin watches `SearchExtension.settings` with flush:'sync' so `Indexer.configure()` has already taken the new exclude list when the rebuild starts a tick later. CodeMirror's basicSetup already binds Mod-Enter to insertBlankLine and wins on precedence — the run chord needs Prec.highest or it silently adds a line instead (caught in the browser, not by a test). @codemirror/lang-sql needs no new dependency: LanguageDescription.matchLanguageName over @codemirror/language-data resolves it lazily and the client build code-splits it into its own chunk. Panel/section ids live in contributions.ts because SearchRail opens the console panel and the plugin imports SearchRail — a constant on the plugin would close an import cycle. e2e: openSettingsSection had to be scoped to .settings-nav, since the section and the mini-app are both called 'Search' and the desktop rail key matched too. Still NOT config, deliberately: batchSize (a checkpoint granularity, not a user setting, and absent from the BE schema list), DEFAULT_SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS (200, the field's own keystroke debounce) and DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT (50, the result page size). statement_timeout is still armed and still never fires in PGlite 0.5.4 — 'sql.timeoutMs' reaches the engine and shows in the console's meta line, but no query is actually cut short; QA check 5 and the timeout half of acceptance criterion 3 cannot pass as written. FIX PASS (boot-blocking start): the first cut had start() await the config read and openSqlIndex, which held the first paint for a cold PGlite (~1s) and made the shared e2e `app` fixture time out under parallel load. start() now sets status='opening' and returns; the whole bring-up runs detached and every read path awaits the readiness promise. start() is deliberately NOT async — with an await before the bring-up is assigned, a stop() in the same tick sees nothing to wait for AND the resumed start() resets `stopping` back to false, so the bring-up opens an index nothing is left to close (verified: the async form crashes the vitest worker on a leaked PGlite). stop() awaits the bring-up and the bring-up re-checks `stopping` after every await. `ref()` deep-proxies its value, so an identity guard against DEFAULT_SEARCH_SETTINGS was silently always false and the config file was never applied — settings is a shallowRef now and the guard is an explicit `settingsApplied` boolean. A race test needs a gate, not a sleep: the sleep version passes even with stop()'s await removed (the bring-up's own checkpoints cover that path), so the real test parks the config read through a ScopedFileSystem subclass and asserts stop() has not resolved. The plugin is testable without ArxHub — ExtensionContainer + a LazyContainer with VaultVfs/VaultWatcher + an EventEmitter is a usable PluginContext (hence the new @arxhub/di, @arxhub/events and eventemitter3 dev deps). Pre-existing and left alone: a word typed in the first second answers over an empty index and the list then sits stale, because readiness means 'the index opened', not 'the walk finished', and the search controller only re-runs on a change.
